```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |> schema()
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(average_market_cap = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(average_market_cap)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_raw)) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |> rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(
    launch_date_parsed = coalesce(
      lubridate::ymd(launch_date, quiet = TRUE),
      lubridate::mdy(launch_date, quiet = TRUE)
    )
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(metadata$launch_date_parsed))

metadata |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_raw)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line()
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(category_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(category_share = category_market_cap / sum(category_market_cap)) |>
  mutate(category_name = forcats::fct_reorder(category_name, category_share, .fun = mean, .desc = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = category_share, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area() +
  geom_rect(
    data = tibble(
      start = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
      end = as.Date(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11"))
    ),
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = tibble(
      date = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
      event = c("Luna/UST crash", "FTX collapse")
    ),
    aes(x = date, y = 1.04, label = event),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis", name = "Category") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.1), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market Capitalization by Category",
    subtitle = "Each band shows its category's share of tracked crypto market cap per day; bands sum to 100%.",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of total market cap",
    caption = "Source: Daily prices, coin metadata, and category classifications from PPBDS misc.tutorials."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
